home.tagline: Maps where time is a first-class dimension.
home.intro: Universal Calendar Map is a static, browser-only map engine that treats a calendar as an equal first-class dimension alongside geography. Each world below is a self-contained data package — its own map, layers, dates and content. Pick one to explore it.
home.addWorld.title: Add your own world
home.addWorld.step1: Create a folder `worlds/<id>/` with a `world.json`: the map centre, base layers and calendar range.
home.addWorld.step2: Add a layer file `layers/<name>.layer.json` (how to draw and filter) and its `data/<name>.geojson` (the places; add `temporal` for dates).
home.addWorld.step3: Register it with one entry in `AVAILABLE_WORLDS` (`src/ui/worlds.ts`) and add its `worlds.<id>.label` and `worlds.<id>.description` to `public/strings/site.*.json`.
home.addWorld.step4: Run `pnpm dev` and open `/<id>/`. For its own domain: `vite build --mode <id>`.
